text: First and foremost, it would be a sound policy for you to [action], which will notably [benefit].

text: Furthermore, you are kindly expected to [action] so that [positive_outcome].

text: I sincerely hope that these humble suggestions will be taken into favorable consideration.
intent: 尾段表达谦逊期许与采纳愿望

text: Learning that you are [occasion/activity], I am writing with immense enthusiasm to recommend [subject] to you.

text: [Subject], a [status_or_definition] boasting [unique_features], serves as a quintessential choice for [audience].

text: For your [activity], it is strongly advisable to [tip1] alongside [tip2].

text: I feel compelled to write this email to lodge a formal complaint regarding [product/service] (Order No. [id]).

text: I have long placed high trust in your [reputation]; nevertheless, this recent purchase has brought me nothing but severe frustration due to [defect].
intent: 次段对比期待与现实，直指严重缺陷

slots.[reputation]: 过往良好声誉或品牌信赖
slots.[defect]: 具体故障或不作为事实

text: Under these circumstances, I feel fully justified in requesting an immediate [replacement/full refund].
intent: 次段正式提出法定补救诉求（退货/换货/赔偿）

text: Your prompt attention and a timely resolution to this matter would be highly appreciated.
intent: 尾段敦促迅速解决并保留进一步维权权利

text: I am writing this email to convey my sincerest apologies for my failure to [scheduled_action].

text: I had fully intended to [original_plan]; regrettably, [unexpected_accident], which made it virtually impossible for me to [fulfill_obligation].
intent: 次段解释突发客观不可抗力原由

intent: 次段提出周全补救方案与重新约定

text: Once again, please accept my heartfelt apologies for the inconvenience caused. I look forward to your kind understanding.
intent: 尾段再次诚恳致歉并期盼宽宥与回信

text: On behalf of [organization], I have the supreme honor of inviting you to be our keynote speaker at [event].
intent: 组织者身份正式邀请学者/专家作主旨演讲

text: The [event] is scheduled to take place at [time] on [date] in [venue], aiming to explore [theme]. Given your profound authority in this domain, your speech would provide attendees with invaluable insights.

text: We would be truly grateful if you could favor us with a reply confirming your availability by [deadline]. Should you require any further details, please contact me without hesitation.

text: I am writing this letter to express my deepest gratitude for your warm hospitality and generous support during [occasion].

text: Had it not been for your considerate guidance, I could never have [achieved_milestone] so smoothly.

text: Whenever you visit [place] in the future, please do let me know so that I can return your wonderful kindness. Wish you health and happiness.

text: An effective starting point would be focusing on [subject], which offers rich material for [goal]. In addition, incorporating [tools/aids] will notably engage your audience.

intent: 尾段肯定鼓励并提供预演或协同支持

intent: 通用应用文尾段礼貌if条件句保障支持
